history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue to reinforce financial diligence with vendors both at the selection phase and in cases when significant and persistent issues affect the ongoing performance of the contract.
history.administration_response: The Administration continues to strengthen due diligence regarding vendors’ financial health, in particular for categories and contracts considered to be at a higher risk. To this end, the Administration has implemented more stringent financial criteria to address current dynamic market developments in the areas of construction, fuel, food rations and aviation. In addition, the Department of Operational Support also conducts an annual financial re-evaluation of vendors whose contracts are above a given threshold to review their most recent financial health and detect any potential financial risk. Noting that the Administration has already implemented more stringent financial evaluation criteria for specific categories and introduced an annual re-evaluation of suppliers with significant contracts and continues to further review the financial criteria for other categories as ongoing process, and taking into account the aforementioned, the Administration requests the Board to close the recommendation.
history.board_assessment: The provided evidence and the revised processes indicate that the Administration has taken action to fully implement the recommendation.
